design_purpose.patch_metres: Eleven-metre living groups separated by quiet passages, seeded with the saved world.
design_purpose.shore_width_m: Dry bank planting fades back to ordinary meadow/woodland over seven metres from actual lake columns.
design_purpose.tall_band_m: Taller decorative rush leaves occupy only the inner three metres of bank or fen patch hearts.
design_purpose.sparse_coverage: Ten percent low growth in openings keeps routes and shoreline visible.
design_purpose.dense_coverage: Up to 78 percent of eligible supported roots grow in patch hearts; never a uniform reed ring.
design_purpose.tall_share: Under half the patch-heart roots are tall, leaving gaps among the low sedge and fern.
design_purpose.plant_width_m: A 68-centimetre moving footprint fits inside a one-metre native cell.
design_purpose.sedge_height_m: Low splayed 29-centimetre leaves join damp ground to surrounding turf.
design_purpose.rush_height_m: 86-centimetre upright leaves frame water without harvestable seed heads or eye-height walls.
design_purpose.minimum_scale: Seeded 72–100 percent variation breaks up repeated plant silhouettes.
design_purpose.home_open_radius_m: Eleven metres around the lake home keeps only low cover and preserves the open outlook; not a building boundary.
design_purpose.ground_mix: Restrained damp litter colour, matte and cosmetic; no water, displacement or changed support.
